asm_ida_com:
push    rbp
mov     rbp, rsp
sub     rsp, 60h
mov     [rbp+out], rdi
mov     [rbp+key], rsi
mov     [rbp+in], rdx
lea     rdi, [rbp+block]; dst
mov     rsi, cs:chacha20_constant; src
mov     edx, 4; size
call    load32_le_buf
lea     rdi, [rbp+block]
add     rdi, 10h; dst
mov     rsi, [rbp+key]; src
mov     edx, 8; size
call    load32_le_buf
lea     rdi, [rbp+block]
add     rdi, 30h ; '0'; dst
mov     rsi, [rbp+in]; src
mov     edx, 4; size
call    load32_le_buf
lea     rdi, [rbp+block]; out
lea     rsi, [rbp+block]; in
call    chacha20_rounds
mov     rdi, [rbp+out]; dst
lea     rsi, [rbp+block]; src
mov     edx, 4; size
call    store32_le_buf
mov     rdi, [rbp+out]
add     rdi, 10h; dst
lea     rsi, [rbp+block]
add     rsi, 30h ; '0'; src
mov     edx, 4; size
call    store32_le_buf
lea     rdi, [rbp+block]; secret
mov     esi, 40h ; '@'; size
call    crypto_wipe
add     rsp, 60h
pop     rbp
retn
